title: Replication archive: Surrogate and boundary-condition errors in graded gyroid-sheet optimization: an independent verification study
description:
Code, solver inputs, search records, finite-element solver summaries and raw coupon records behind every number in the article "Surrogate and boundary-condition errors in graded gyroid-sheet optimization: an independent verification study", submitted to Structural and Multidisciplinary Optimization.

python reproduce/check_tables.py recomputes every table entry (500 cells); python reproduce/regenerate_figures.py rebuilds the nine data figures and compares them with the published files. MANIFEST.sha256 lists every file. See README.md and CLAIM_MAP.md.
